summary: Tested the Referentes master catalog and its use in Contacto Inicial, on both backend and frontend at 1366x768. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. They cover GET (active only, A-Z, contactos, can_create), include_inactive, POST with the 409 case-insensitive duplicate and 422 validation, PUT (edit, inactivate, rename updating referred_by), merge (reassigns contacts, sources hidden even from include_inactive), POST initial-contacts with nuevo_referente (creates and links, same name reuses without duplicating), invalid referente_id gives 400, audit CREATE in module Referentes, and RBAC 403 for qa.editor. Extra edge script: a non-admin with the special permission referentes:crear (granted temporarily, then reverted) can quick-create, gets can_create=true and still gets 403 on PUT. Frontend: picker search, Otro option, quick form, 2nd contact list, edit picker, the whole catalog page and the AdminProfiles permission all work. One HIGH UI bug: when the quick form is open, the 'Crear Contacto' button cannot be reached at 1366x768.

minor.issue: create_or_get_referente matches on nombre_norm without checking estatus. If the name belongs to an INACTIVE referente, the contact is silently linked to that inactive referente, which then does not show in the picker. Verified: TEST_Inact_* linked with estatus False. Fix: reactivate it, or return 409 / a clear message.

resolve_contact_referente accepts a referente_id of an inactive referente (and of a merged one) and links it (verified 200). It should reject estatus=False or merged_into referentes, or move a merged one to its target.

A referente link cannot be removed. The picker option 'Sin referente' (edit-referred-by-none) sends nothing, because referentePayload returns {}. Sending referente_id:'' is also ignored: the contact keeps its referente (verified).
The legacy free-text referred_by is still accepted without linking (referente_id=None). This bypasses the catalog, so free-text referidos can keep being created through the API.
No check that the target is active and not merged; you can merge into an inactive referente. No unique index on referentes.nombre_norm, so two concurrent creates can make duplicates.

ui_bugs.component: InitialContacts create modal + ReferentePicker quick form
ui_bugs.issue: At 1366x768, choosing '+ Otro' makes the 'Nuevo Contacto Inicial' dialog about 1008px tall: top at -120px, submit at y=831. DialogContent has no max-h/overflow-y-auto, so the dialog cannot be scrolled with the mouse wheel and the 'Crear Contacto' button is out of reach. Pressing Enter in a field is the only way to submit. Fix: add className 'max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto' to DialogContent (create-contact-modal), and ideally to the edit modal too.

issues: The route has no admin guard: only the sidebar link is hidden. A non-admin who types the URL loads the page, but the API blocks writes (same pattern as other catalogs).
There is no delete, so inactive TEST/duplicate referentes pile up under the 'Todos' filter, which is the default. Consider defaulting the filter to 'Activos'.
The red IntenseAlertToast ('Nuevo Contacto Inicial registrado') sits on top of the 'Nuevo Contacto' button in the top-right and blocks clicks until it is dismissed. This is not new to this feature.

action_items: HIGH: add max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto to the create-contact-modal DialogContent (and the edit modal) so 'Crear Contacto' can be reached at 1366x768 when the quick referente form is open.
Handle a quick-create whose name matches an inactive referente: reactivate it or warn, instead of silently linking to the inactive record.
Reject an inactive or merged referente_id in POST/PUT initial-contacts.
Make 'Sin referente' in the edit picker actually remove the link (e.g. send referente_id:null and handle it in edit_initial_contact).
Optional: stop accepting free-text referred_by without a referente; add a unique index on referentes.nombre_norm (partial, non-null).
critical_code_review_comments: referentes.py create_or_get_referente: find_one by nombre_norm ignores estatus; no unique index, so there is a race on concurrent creates.
initial_contacts.py edit: incoming.pop('referente_id') plus 'if referente and ...' means a falsy referente_id never removes the link.
Referentes.jsx: the 'all' status filter is the default; the frontend route has no admin guard.
audit_trail: CREATE and UPDATE for referentes are recorded (verified via GET /api/audit-trails?modules=Referentes).

success_rate.frontend: about 90% (all flows work; HIGH modal overflow at 1366x768)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ contacts (all deleted by id) and TEST_ referentes (all inactivated; there is no delete endpoint, so they stay in the DB as inactive). qa.editor special_permissions was temporarily given 'referentes:crear' and restored to [] afterwards. CCM was untouched: still 1 linked contact.
